properties.evidence: BL-155 records the hazard in its own words — 'a capability nobody can find is worth what an absent one is worth' — and its group (c) is exactly this failure: reads that answer real questions on designs that exist today, which nobody reaches for. This node is the answer to that hazard rather than another measurement of it: BL-155 asks WHICH tools are unreachable, this asks WHY retrieval fails and what would fix it.
